impact: If re-sharing is interrupted, the app can keep showing a share link as active even though people who open it cannot join.
Someone trying the demo can be blocked from signing in because an optional step of saving their account name failed.
Pressing Publish a second time can make a change that was already released successfully show the wrong release status.
A published change can appear stuck on "waiting to deploy" forever even though it is already live as part of a later release.
If a publish fails its automatic checks, trying to publish the same change again fails too until leftovers from the first attempt are cleaned up.
If a page freezes after loading, further core changes to the app can stay blocked indefinitely because the previous one never lets go of its turn.
If two projects are set up to use the same working folder, the nightly review can mix up their histories and report findings against the wrong project.
A notice saying the camera failed stays on screen indefinitely unless the user does something with their draft.

Only the developers' tests are affected: a check that members are kept out of the nightly review can pass even when that feature is broken for an unrelated reason, so a real problem could go unnoticed.
Only the developers' tests are affected: a check on the page footer will start failing once the year is no longer 2026, even though the app itself is fine.
Only the developers' tests are affected: the test suite cannot start at all when the project is downloaded without its full history, even with browser tests switched off.
Only the developers' tests are affected: a check of the iPad layout fails to start when the tests are run in the Firefox browser.
